benchmark: ADR-010 C.3: the cascade on a scale journal under the frozen lifecycle

lifecycle_config.compared_with: the last phase event as the progress file copied it from the frozen scheduler (the log's prefix being hash checked at every resumption)

k_label: the system's k (journal_k of the checkpoint's configuration)

faults.condition: the withdrawal under cascade holds on every phase

phase_times_label: the time is the lifecycle's bookkeeping as frozen, not the index's or the memory's
phase_times_what: the frozen code's time per phase: the period's writes through the scheduler and the phase they fire, from the end of the probe's work after the previous phase to the end of the write that fired this one
probe_times_what: the probe's own time after each phase: the withdrawal check, the state counts, the reads and the reconstruction reading at a read phase, the recorded point's synchronisation; not in the phase times
n_units_what: the recorded points (the phases), not the writes

near_duplicates.read_before_eviction_what: the duplicate's line in the window of any read (a sample read or a pair read) at a read phase before the phase of its eviction
